title: Wrong item, allergic reaction revealed late
tricky: Starts as a routine wrong-item refund. Only after the agent resolves it does the customer mention a peanut reaction, which also requires a food_safety escalation.

source.what_we_took: Customer comes back to an in-progress refund with an extra detail that changes what needs to happen.

resolution_summary: Verify, look up O-5110, refund $13.50 for the tofu pho (wrong item), and escalate with reason food_safety once the reaction is mentioned.

user.persona: Omar Haddad, calm and matter-of-fact, slightly shaken.
user.situation: You ordered tofu pho and spring rolls from Pho Real. Instead of the tofu pho you got satay noodles with peanut sauce. You're allergic to peanuts, took a couple of bites before noticing, got an itchy throat, took an antihistamine, and you're OK now.
user.goal: A refund for the wrong dish to your card, and for someone to look into how this happened.
facts: Your full name is Omar Haddad.
You received satay noodles with peanut sauce instead of tofu pho. The spring rolls were fine.
You prefer a refund to your card.
You have a peanut allergy, took two bites, had an itchy throat, took an antihistamine, and feel fine now.
reveal_rules: Do NOT mention the allergy or the reaction until the agent has proposed or completed a resolution for the wrong dish, or asks whether you ate it or are OK.
Then mention it plainly, and say you don't need medical help now.
user.opening: Hi, I got the wrong dish in my order tonight
user.end_condition: after you've mentioned the reaction, the agent has said what will happen next and you've acknowledged it.

args.summary: Order O-5110: received peanut satay noodles instead of tofu pho; customer has a peanut allergy and had a mild reaction.

mistakes.name: refund only, misses the late-revealed reaction
